settings.title: Crafted for Effortless Speed
settings.body: Hyperion Titanium II, Power Frame 2.0, and high-repulsion face technology deliver pure energy transfer with every strike.

settings.title: Stability in Every Swing
settings.body: Full Tungsten Sole construction and Optimal Core Impact design ensure consistent launch, forgiveness, and control across the entire clubface.

settings.title: Ultra-Light Precision
settings.body: LV770 and TL770 carbon shafts engineered for smooth acceleration, refined tempo, and unmatched feel through impact.

settings.hero_sub: Crafted in Japan. Available at Northcrest.
settings.statement_body: Majesty's Prestigio 14 Series represents the marriage of hand-finished detail and material science—engineered for golfers who value precision, refinement, and effortless speed. Northcrest is honored to present this rare collection.
settings.heritage_para: Majesty selects only a handful of retailers worldwide to represent the Prestigio line. Northcrest is **one of nine** locations in the United States entrusted with this collection. Our team offers personalized guidance to help you experience the full performance of these handcrafted clubs.
